Officer's narrative
Responding to a report of a two-vehicle collision in Conroe, Texas, I found Driver 1 and Driver 2 at the scene. The
collision occurred when Driver 2 changed lanes and the side of their vehicle contacted the side of Driver 1's vehicle.
Damage to both vehicles is consistent with that sideswipe, and I observed no older damage on either one.
Photographs taken at the scene show the damage locations and the final rest positions of the vehicles. No
independent witnesses came forward. Driver 1 stated that a passenger was riding in the front seat at the time, and
both drivers confirmed the passenger's presence, which I also observed on arrival. Driver 1 reported pain in the neck
and lower back, and those complaints are consistent with the forces expected in this type of impact. Driver 1 provided
documentation identifying them as the named policyohlder on the vehicle involved. Both drivers were cooperative,
and the scene was cleared after the vehicles were moved to the shoulder.
